---
title: "Curated Opportunity List — E-01"
labels: ["feature", "entrepreneur", "priority/1"]
assignees: []
---

As an Entrepreneur, I want a curated list of opportunities so I can pick one to validate quickly.

Acceptance criteria:
- List shows tags, effort estimate, template link and owner.
- Bookmark an opportunity and see it in user profile.
- Mobile and desktop layouts supported.

Notes:
- Seed with 10 sample opportunities for validation testing.
